set ACL for BACKOFFICE_TOOLS_USER_GROUP 
 allow jcr:read on /libs
end

set ACL for BACKOFFICE_TOOLS_USER_GROUP 
 deny jcr:read on /apps restriction(rep:glob,/*)
 allow jcr:read on /apps restriction(rep:glob)
 allow jcr:read on /apps/backoffice-tools
end

set ACL for BACKOFFICE_TOOLS_USER_GROUP 
 allow jcr:read on /apps/cq
end

set ACL for BACKOFFICE_TOOLS_USER_GROUP 
 deny jcr:read on /etc restriction(rep:glob,/*)
 allow jcr:read on /etc restriction(rep:glob)
 deny jcr:read on /etc/nodesData restriction(rep:glob,/*)
 allow jcr:read on /etc/nodesData restriction(rep:glob)
 allow jcr:all on /etc/nodesData/warrantyData
end
